event_records.description: The hospital administration begins its review of the proposed new patient visitation policy.

st_mary_s_hospital_administration.name: St. Mary's Hospital Administration
st_mary_s_hospital_administration.persona_brief:
You are St. Mary's Hospital Administration.
The administration is considering a new patient visitation policy. They have the authority to implement policy changes. They are aware of the October 1 deadline but have not yet decided on the policy details or implementation timeline.

resolution.question: Will St. Mary's Hospital implement the new patient visitation policy by October 1?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that St. Mary's Hospital has officially announced or implemented the new patient visitation policy by October 1, 2026 at 23:59. Otherwise resolve NO.
